basic_details.job_title: ICAR CIFE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Research Associate, Junior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: ICAR-Central Institute of Fisheries Education (ICAR-CIFE) has announced 2 contractual vacancies for Research Associate (RA) and Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts for a period of three years. Interested candidates must submit their application by email on or before 7 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: ICAR-CIFE has released 2 vacancies on a purely contractual and temporary basis under the DBT-funded research project.

rows.monthly_emolument: Rs. 37,000 (1st & 2nd year fixed); Rs. 42,000 (3rd year fixed)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Eligibility requirements including essential qualifications, research experience, and age limits vary by post as detailed below. The upper age limits for the posts are as follows: Research Associate (RA): Upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women. Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Upper age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women. Age Relaxation: Candidates claiming age relaxations on account of category, previous employment, or any other as applicable under Government of India norms must send supporting certificates along with documents. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary, time-bound, and co-terminus with the DBT-funded scheme for a period of three years. Service conditions and tenure are governed by ICAR guidelines. The appointed personnel will have no legal right or claim to regular appointment, absorption, or further contractual engagement under ICAR. The post-wise monthly emoluments are: Research Associate (RA): Rs. 61,000/- plus 30% HRA per month. Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Rs. 37,000/- fixed per month for the first and second year; Rs. 42,000/- fixed per month for the third year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CIFE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official application form format provided with the recruitment notification. Fill in all relevant personal details, category, educational qualifications (from 10th standard through post-graduation), NET/GATE status, and publications. Fill in current employment details and prior work experience along with organization details and duration. Paste a recent passport-size photograph in the space provided on the form and sign the declaration. Attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, mark sheets, proof of age, category/relaxation certificates (if applicable), experience documents, and research publications. Send the completed application form and all enclosures by email to [email protected] on or before 07 November 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only the candidates who fulfill all the eligibility conditions will be invited to appear for the walk-in-interview. Basis of Selection: Academic performance, research experience, and performance during the interview. Interview Date and Time: 16 November 2026, starting from 11:00 AM onwards. Interview Venue: ICAR-CIFE, Yari Road Campus, Panch Marg, Off Yari Road, Versova, Andheri (West), Mumbai-400061. Travel Expenses: TA/DA will not be provided. Authority: The decision of the Director, ICAR-CIFE, Mumbai will be final and binding in all aspects.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are released under ICAR-CIFE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 contractual vacancies: 1 for Research Associate (RA) and 1 for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application for ICAR-CIFE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email to [email protected] is 07 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When and where will the walk-in-interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in-interview will be held on 16 November 2026 from 11:00 AM onwards at ICAR-CIFE, Yari Road campus, Versova, Andheri (West), Mumbai.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an M.F.Sc. in Fish Biotechnology or M.Sc. in Life Science/Biotechnology, with 3 years of research experience in Genome Editing, Cell Culture, or Biotechnology, and at least 2 research publications in the relevant field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.F.Sc. in Fish Biotechnology or M.Sc. in Life Science/Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for RA and JRF posts?
faq.answer: For Research Associate, the upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women; for Junior Research Fellow, it is 35 years for men and 40 years for women.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly pay for these posts?
faq.answer: The Research Associate receives Rs. 61,000 + 30% HRA per month, while the Junior Research Fellow receives Rs. 37,000 fixed per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 fixed per month in the third year.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for ICAR-CIFE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely contractual and temporary for a period of three years, co-terminus with the DBT-funded project, with no claim for regular absorption under ICAR.

faq.question: Q10. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxations are available for category candidates and those with previous employment as per Government of India norms, subject to the submission of supporting certificates.
